name: Is it better to paint kitchen cabinets or replace them entirely?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to paint kitchen cabinets or replace them entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting existing cabinets costs significantly less than a full replacement, typically saving homeowners 50% to 70% compared to new custom or semi-custom cabinetry. However, the tradeoff is that painting preserves your current kitchen layout, door profile, and cabinet interior structure. Painting is an ideal choice if your cabinet boxes and face frames are structurally sound and you simply want an aesthetic update. If your existing layout lacks functionality, has water-damaged particle board, or requires major reconfiguration, investing in cabinet replacement during a full kitchen remodel may be the better long-term decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting is 50% to 70% cheaper and preserves your existing layout if boxes are sound. Replace them if you want a new layout, modern storage features, or have water-damaged cabinet boxes.
